# Mergers & Acquisitions covers Burford's minority stake in Kindleworth


- Law firm equity


September 9, 2025


-
-
-
-


*Mergers & Acquisitions* reported on Burford's recent strategic minority investment in Kindleworth, noting that the partnership allows for the combination of "Burford's legal finance experience and global reach with Kindleworth's track record of supporting entrepreneurial lawyers in building successful practices."


[Read the full article here.](https://www.reuters.com/legal/legalindustry/burford-drills-down-law-firm-strategy-with-uk-advisory-deal-2025-09-09/https://www.themiddlemarket.com/latest-news/burford-capital-takes-minority-stake-in-kindleworth)
